idea-plugin.name: Review Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Review GitHub pull requests inside your IDE, with the whole codebase around them.

A diff page shows the lines that changed. To judge them you need the rest: the caller, the test, the config. Review Lens checks the pull request out in the window you already have open, so you read full files with every IDE tool, then puts you back exactly where you were.

  • Your work stays safe: uncommitted changes are parked in a named git stash and restored exactly on Exit.
  • Read the change in context: full files, read-only, with changes marked in the gutter and a diff one click away.
  • Track progress: ⭐ not viewed, ✅ viewed, 🔄 changed since viewed, synced with GitHub's Viewed checkboxes.
  • Comment, then post once: inline drafts, a summary and a verdict go to GitHub as a single review.
  • Review only what's new: all commits, a few, or only those pushed since your last review.
  • Works offline: without GitHub it lists branches instead, and viewed ticks sync later.

Requires git and the GitHub CLI signed in (gh auth login). Open the Review tool window, or click Review PR… in the toolbar.

idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.2

  • Ready for upcoming IDE versions: no longer uses an API JetBrains has scheduled for removal, and no longer builds against deprecated or experimental platform APIs it never needed.
  • A fuller plugin page: features, requirements and links to the user guide.

0.1.1

  • First release: review a pull request in the window you already have open, with your work parked and restored, a viewed checklist synced with GitHub, inline comments posted as one review, and blame on the caret line.
